title: Normalized natural augmentation of strict Koszul tensor towers to quotient towers
statement: Let C be a small category with Grothendieck topology J, A a commutative ring, I an ideal, b a Boolean, r a natural number and a : Fin r → A with span(range a)=I. Use O_b and its finite coefficient maps from [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data], the strict reduction complex functor T_b from [def-pur-strict-quotient-completion-data], and the actual dual Koszul tensor tower functor G_a from [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system] on the global sections algebraSection(baseMap_b)(a_i). There exists a natural transformation α : G_a → T_b on all cochain complexes of O_b-modules. For every complex P, its actual ordinary Koszul limit unit followed by ordinaryLimit(α_P) equals ordinaryUnit_b(P). For every level n, every pair of tensor degrees p,q with q≠0, the inclusion of the summand P^p tensor (dual Koszul tower at n)^q followed by (α_P)_n in degree p+q is zero. These two conditions are precisely KoszulQuotientAugmentationLaws. No Noetherian, boundedness or completeness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Dualize each positive two-term Koszul factor and total tensor in the given order. In degree zero send the coefficient unit to the finite coefficient quotient; send all other Koszul degrees to zero. The differential into degree zero has entries a_i^(n+1), which vanish in A/I^(n+1). Thus these components define an augmentation chain map, and the empty tensor is covered by the same quotient map.

Dual power transitions are identity in degree zero. Quotient transitions preserve residue classes, so these augmentations commute strictly with every tower arrow. Tensor with P and use the balancing isomorphism P tensor res(S_n) ≅ res(S_n tensor P) to identify the target with the specified reduction complex; the coproduct maps are zero on every nonzero Koszul-degree summand.

Naturality follows on each total-tensor summand from tensor functoriality and the balancing formula. On the degree-zero unit p maps to p tensor 1 and then to 1 tensor p, the prescribed reduction unit. Compose with each ordinary-limit projection to obtain the asserted equality, since those projections are jointly monic.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulQuotientAugmentation (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = I) :
    ∃ α : ringedKoszulTensorTowerFunctor (coefficients J A I b) r
        (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap J A I b) (a i)) ⟶
      (reductionTower J A I b).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ),
      KoszulQuotientAugmentationLaws J A I b r a α
